title: Kim Kardashian Starring in Bratz Movie | E! News
text:
Kim Kardashian is producing and starring in a big-screen take on the Bratz doll toy brand. The reality star is being eyed for a villain role in the adaptation, following her upcoming turn in Ryan Murphy’s ‘All’s Fair’ on Hulu.
